column1: # Held-out corpus manifest, 2026-09-27. One row per corpus file, vulnerable PARENT side only.
# The corpus itself is NOT committed (third-party source; public repo). blob_sha1 is what
# `gh api repos/<repo>/contents/<path>?ref=<parent> --jq .sha` returns. Files the fix commit
# ADDED do not exist at the parent and are listed with status=added and no blob.
